D/16 IA No.2 of 2025
In
AO No.340 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Mr. T.A. Khan, Senior Advocate 
assisted by Ms. Sheeba Ahmed, 
Advocate for the appellant.
 Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate for the 
respondent nos.1 to 4.
 Heard on Delay Condonation 
Application (IA) No.2 of 2025.
 This is an appeal against award of 
compensation in a motor accident 
claim case. 
 Service is sufficient on all the 
respondents. 
 Respondent nos.1 to 5 are being 
represented.
 There is no objection, as such on 
the delay condonation application.
 Having considered, the grounds of 
delay are good enough to condone the 
delay. Therefore, delay in filing the 
appeal is condoned. 
 Delay condonation application is 
allowed.
 On admission, learned 
Senior Counsel for the appellant 
seeks time.
 List on 19.06.2026. 
 
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 22.05.2026
Sanjay
